notes:
A leaderboard for the people who run the company. If you are HR, the CEO, the MD or a Super Admin, Incentive now has a Leaderboard of its own — on the Admin hub and in the Menu. It ranks everybody by the points they earned in the month, across every department, with a filter to look at one department at a time and a switch to hide anyone who has not earned any.

Ranks belong to the company, not to the list in front of you: filter down to one department and whoever is third overall still reads #3 rather than being renumbered to first. It shows points earned and nothing else — what anybody has been paid, or is still owed, stays on the Points Dashboard where it belongs.

If you are one of those four, the leaderboard on your own My Incentive now covers every department too. It used to stop at yours, which made little sense when the same account already reads every department's points, and their pay, on the Points Dashboard.

For everybody else nothing changes: My Incentive works exactly as it did, and which departments you can see on its leaderboard is still your Super Admin's setting.
